description: This file defines the VulnerabilitiesController class for handling API endpoints related to vulnerabilities, including CRUD operations, remediation generation, and associated actions within an ASP.NET Core Web API project.

classes.name: VulnerabilitiesController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, deleting, and managing vulnerabilities, including remediation and notifications.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new vulnerability record.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing vulnerability by ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of vulnerabilities with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a single vulnerability by ID, including related entities.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a vulnerability by ID.

methods.name: PutRemediation
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to generate and update remediation instructions for a vulnerability, notify the user, and push a notification to Redis.
